name: walterreid-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Walter Reid. before-compact keeps your last turns, verbatim, across a compaction, and shows what each compaction did.

plugins.name: before-compact
plugins.description: Keeps your last turns, verbatim, across a Claude Code compaction: a PreCompact hook saves them and the window's full arc, a SessionStart hook puts them back, and the /before-compact pane shows each compaction's numbers, the engine's summary, and what was re-injected.

plugins.name: build-contract
plugins.description: The Build Contract: a seven-document system for long, multi-session AI builds — tiered rules with a real amendment channel, a handoff maintained from day zero, and a read-receipt gate. The blueprint for the last 10%. Skills and templates only; no hooks.
